title: AIMProfiles
description: AI Module Profile (MPAI-PRF V2.0): the Attributes, and Sub-Attributes, that an AIM instance signals, as ALL (the listed Attributes are not supported) or NUL (the listed Attributes are supported) followed by +/- Attributes, @EPS#<Sub-Attributes: PST text, PSS speech, PSF face, PSB body> and @TRN#<language><->|-><language>. Corrections to V1.0: PST (the text Sub-Attribute, SPT in V1.0), PSB (body, PSG for gesture in V1.0), AVS (Audio-Visual Scene Descriptors) is an Attribute, ISD is not.
